positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Work with clients and cross-functional teams to build and release new features for full stack web applications. Clients are in industries including healthcare records, consulting, and renewable energy IoT systems.
- Built vector-based data visualizations (maps and charts) to support complex reporting views for a big data application using D3, Vue, and Javascript technologies.
- Migrated a legacy API system from a virtual machine runtime to an AWS Lambda/OpenAPI runtime. Built tests to verify consistency.
- Developed a MQTT Gateway for a distributed battery storage system product in the solar industry. Built features including provisioning, data ingestion, OTA updates.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Provided technical sales and support across five commercial building controls product lines, including laboratory HVAC controls, gas detection systems, and air/liquid flow meters.
- Personally generated enough new service revenue to double company-wide service revenue through equipment startup, troubleshooting, diagnosis and calibration projects.
- Developed trusted relationships with customer and increased sales by solving difficult technical questions and communicating effectively with multiple stakeholders

positions.title: Tesla Advisor - Virtual Team
positions.description:
- Worked with customers and internal teams to support a high volume of vehicle deliveries across three states.
- Gained a thorough understanding of Tesla's internal delivery and customer support systems.

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description:
- Solar Decathlon Africa is a U.S. Dept of Energy collegiate competition that challenges student teams to design and build highly efficient and innovative buildings powered by renewable energy. The winners are the teams that best blend architectural, design, and engineering excellence with innovation, market potential, building efficiency, and smart energy production.
- Developed the energy control and visualization system for this smart home prototype. Contributed to the backend data model and created a user interface, energy visualization, and natural language assistant to interact with the system in English, French, or Arabic.
- Collaborated with building architects, electricians, and event administrators to finalize designs and install and test various building systems on an accelerated schedule.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Contributor to the engineering teams that designed, manufactured and commissioned the PSL Grid Thumper™, a tool for testing, measuring and characterizing the stability of the electric grid. This shipping container-sized device controls large, precisely timed pulses of electric current, perturbing the steady-state voltages to reveal unique stability characteristics of the local grid. The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) funded the project to study cyber-physical security of the electric grid. 
- Worked on testing, provisioning, and configuration of Linux-based microcomputers used in the control system. Collaborated with software, and manufacturing teams.

positions.title: Owner and Technician
positions.description: During high school, I operated a computer repair business providing computer repair and IT support to local individuals and businesses.

educations.schoolName: Albers School of Business and Economics at Seattle University
